format: r2 formula reference (verification variant, not a patch)

changed_or_added_elements.name: Capital Goods Buffer Days
changed_or_added_elements.description: v7.5: capital goods fulfillment half-saturation expressed in days of current capital goods demand (scale-free).

changed_or_added_elements.name: v7.5 Capital Goods Shock Multiplier
changed_or_added_elements.description: Mode 22 multiplier applied to the selected colony capital-goods production capacity.

changed_or_added_elements.name: A Capital Goods Fulfillment
changed_or_added_elements.r1_value: IfThenElse([Capital Goods Enabled] = 1, [A Capital Goods Inventory] / ([A Capital Goods Inventory] + [Capital Goods Buffer]), 1)
changed_or_added_elements.r2_value: IfThenElse([Capital Goods Enabled] = 1, [A Capital Goods Inventory] / ([A Capital Goods Inventory] + [Capital Goods Buffer Days] * Max([A Capital Goods Demand], 0.000000001)), 1)
changed_or_added_elements.description: Common capital-goods fulfillment factor applied proportionally to all three expanding sectors in colony A.

changed_or_added_elements.name: A Refinery Capital Goods Consumption
changed_or_added_elements.r1_value: [A Refinery Expansion] * [A Refinery Capital Goods per Capacity]
changed_or_added_elements.r2_value: IfThenElse([Capital Goods Enabled] = 1, [A Refinery Expansion] * [A Refinery Capital Goods per Capacity], 0)
changed_or_added_elements.description: Capital goods consumed by refinery expansion in colony A.

changed_or_added_elements.name: A Electronics Capital Goods Consumption

changed_or_added_elements.description: Capital goods consumed by electronics factory expansion in colony A.
